title: Michal and Renata Hornstein Pavilion
geometryBasis: Native pavilion way 47175652 and the official campus membership, preserved in the local Sherbrooke frame.
sectionBasis: Use the verified front original for the recessed four-column Ionic portico, three dark oak arched entrances, central entablature, paired bas-reliefs and narrow tall square lights. The original marble front faces southeast across Sherbrooke Street. Keep pale stone and quiet green coping. Model the north-side additions separately per native outlines.
limitations: Mapped footprint and street axes set position and extent. Unmeasured façade and roof heights, grade transitions and tertiary architectural details are estimates.
The selected CC0 image establishes the principal frontage. Other elevations are reconstructed from the footprint and published design facts.
The underlying campus elevation samples and raw source tiles stay unchanged. The individual base is an approximate fit to the local grade.
